propositions: A new peer confirmation record store must persist vendor link metadata (link_id, direction, confirmed_pass, confirmed_at, source) keyed by (source_local_id, target_local_id, relation) for every successfully applied outbound link

The write seam at _update_one_dispatch_links must invoke an optional link_confirm callback after set_relationship succeeds, extracting link_id from the returned mapping, and swallowing any callback exceptions without affecting link counts or applied status
Unbound targets (where binding_store.get_local_id returns None) must skip confirmation recording entirely rather than persist vendor keys in local-id fields
The peer_confirmations.json file must be staged in both _rel_files and _tracked_basenames so that confirmation-only changes are committed and survive snapshot compaction
Load must be fail-open: corrupt or absent peer_confirmations.json yields an empty store without raising or aborting the reconciliation pass
